title: Base change of an open immersion is an open immersion (Stacks 01JY)
statement: Let $j:W\to X$ be an open immersion of schemes [def-weil-open-immersion] and $g:Z\to X$ any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Then the projection $W\times_XZ\to Z$ from the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] is an open immersion.
